cloudnative-pg.description: Configuration for CNPG operator helm chart. See https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/charts/tree/main/charts/cloudnative-pg for API reference.
cloudnative-pg.title: cloudnative-pg

clusters.description:
CNPG clusters configuration. This is a map where each key corresponds to the PostgreSQL cluster to be provisioned
For Example, see `example-postgredb` definition in Examples-PostgreSQL section below.
By default cluster 'qvt-postgredb' is enabled and provisioned with default configuration.
clusters.title: clusters

defaultClusterSpec.description:
(tpl/string) Default spec for CNPG clusters. See https://cloudnative-pg.io/documentation/current/cloudnative-pg.v1/#postgresql-cnpg-io-v1-ClusterSpec for API reference.
This is templated field which is rendered for each cluster from 'clusters.<cluster>'. Scope for the template contains fields: 
\newline
* addonOperator: content from Addon Operator configmap. You can check if some modules, e.f. monitoring-platform are enabled.
\newline
* root: root context of 'qvantel-glue' module, containing all Values for the module.
\newline
* spec: content of 'spec' field for rendered cluster. It is possible to check if particular default values are overridden.
defaultClusterSpec.title: defaultClusterSpec

s3Bucket.description: Common s3 bucket to store WALs and Backups
s3Bucket.title: s3Bucket

example-postgredb.description:
This is example PostgreSQL cluster definition. 
Note: It is used for documentation purposes only. Real PostgreSQL clusters should be defined under `cnpgPostgresPlatform.clusters`

enabled.description: Enables cluster provisioning. By default 'false' which means cluster will not be deployed.
enabled.title: enabled

scheduledBackup.description: Defines scheduled backup configuration as Cron string (e.g. "0 0 0 * * *" - every midnight). If configured, then (kind: ScheduledBackup) will be created for the cluster with provided schedule.
scheduledBackup.title: scheduledBackup

spec.description:
Configure CNPG cluster details. See https://cloudnative-pg.io/documentation/current/cloudnative-pg.v1/#postgresql-cnpg-io-v1-ClusterSpec for API reference.
Values configured in this spec are merged with default spec from 'cnpgPostgresPlatform.common.defaultClusterSpec'.
spec.title: spec

vaultConfiguration.description: Create Vault configuration for this cluster according to Qvantel conventions, i.e. DbConnection and common DbRoles.
vaultConfiguration.title: vaultConfiguration

example-postgredb.title: example-postgredb

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.
global.title: global
